# Lexology

> > The number one platform for global legal intelligence, providing expert analysis, regulatory monitoring, and AI-powered compliance tools for legal professionals worldwide.

Lexology is a comprehensive legal intelligence platform serving law firms, in-house counsel, and legal professionals with curated legal news, regulatory insights, and thought leadership content. The platform integrates advanced AI technologies and compliance monitoring capabilities to help legal professionals stay informed on jurisdiction-specific developments and emerging legal trends.

## Key Topics

- Artificial Intelligence
- Generative AI
- Legal Intelligence
- Regulatory Compliance
- Regulatory Monitoring
- Compliance Management
- Legal Research Platform
- Law Firm Management
- Data Protection
- ESG
- Legal Professionals
- Kleos Expert AI
- Future Ready Lawyer
- Wolters Kluwer Legal Software

## Core Platform & Subscriptions

- [Lexology Home](https://www.lexology.com): Global legal intelligence platform with expert analysis and legal news
- [Lexology PRO](https://www.lexology.com/pro): Premium subscription service featuring regulatory monitoring, compliance management, and advanced legal intelligence tools

## Community & Thought Leadership

- [Lexology Influencers](https://www.lexology.com/influencers): Ranking system and profiles of leading legal thought leaders and expert contributors
- [Lexology Events](https://www.lexology.com/events): Directory of legal conferences, webinars, and industry events

## Events & Webinars

- [AI and Legal Technology Webinar](https://events.lexology.com/mgxqMA): Specialized webinar featuring AI and legal technology innovations and applications
